question_or_proposition: In Section B(1), does the schedule entry requiring achievement of final cyanide effluent limitations 12 months after the permit effective date establish (a) a deadline by which the permittee must meet cyanide effluent limitations that are otherwise applicable from the permit effective date, or (b) the date from which those final cyanide effluent limitations first become the governing enforceable limits and the date by which associated compliance is considered achieved for purposes of Section B(1)(a) progress-reporting obligations?
required_context: cyanide effluent limitations as specified elsewhere in the permit
Federal FY2025 measurement and reporting periods
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, page 6, section part_i, SECTION B - SCHEDULE OF COMPLIANCE, item 1)
notes: The nominated schedule clause could change which enforceable numeric cyanide limits apply to reported measurements during FY2025 (Purpose A) and whether Section B(1)(a) quarterly progress-reporting obligations remain applicable during FY2025 based on when compliance with cyanide limitations is achieved relative to the 12-month schedule date (Purpose B). The cyanide numeric limits themselves are referenced but not defined in the nominated span.
